title: LA DeepBlack 090 Solo – Ikat
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing, deepest ebony skin with cool blue-black undertones, mid 30s, spoon-shape physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — hips dramatically wider than the upper body, full belly, full bust, enormous thighs, long box braids tied high — full body Central Asian ikat body art from neck to ankle, EVERY inch covered, NO bare skin below neck. Bold black outlines — FUCHSIA, SAFFRON, and TEAL blurred-edge ikat diamonds and pomegranate shapes across torso and both legs to ankle, filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: contrapposto, one foot on a low black block, hand on raised knee, torso upright facing camera, chest and belly fully visible.
Footwear: fuchsia teal platform stiletto sandals with ribbon laces tied below the knee 8 inch. Nails: extra long almond nails, ikat pattern.
Extreme high-gloss oil. MANDATORY pure pitch black background only, NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. CRITICAL: legs show FULL BODY ART coverage hip to ankle to toe. Ikat art must BLAZE against the deepest ebony skin. Emphasis on the extreme body volume. 8K portrait 2:3 vertical.
